text: Today, my boyfriend and I got our teeth cleaned (tartar removed). The work was excellent; the female dentist was incredibly gentle – it didn't hurt at all. I had a cavity that she filled, and it was a bit sensitive during the filling, so she asked if I wanted a local anesthetic. The injection itself was painless, which surprised me! I highly recommend her; she was really good. She also checked each tooth for any gaps between them. 10/10!
